I   INTRODUCTION Ragnarök is upon you, Gods and mortals go to war  against the mighty giants and the undead, kingdoms  collapse, the end approaches, and only the valiant will  be remembered in the saga. Will the Aesir and Vanir  save the Nine Worlds from destruction, or will the  powers of chaos shatter these realms before reducing  Yggdrasil to ashes ? In  Mythic Battles: Ragnarök , 2 to 4 players each form  an army around a divinity from the Norse pantheon, and  then battle it out, individually or as a team, in a scripted  adventure or a pure head-to-head skirmish.  Each player or team of players represents a  side. A  player's army consists of all the units he controls. II   GAME TERMS There are many game terms in  Mythic Battles:  Ragnarök , some of which are also words in common  use. For the full list, see the index on page 32. To avoid  confusion, the following conventions are used:  stats  are written in italics, for example:  offense  or  range ;  Powers and talents are capitalized, for example: Block,  Dragon's Blood or Leader.
